arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT vo.visit_occurrence_id) AS inpatient_encounters_with_pneumonia_past_year
FROM omop.visit_occurrence vo
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
  ON co.visit_occurrence_id = vo.visit_occurrence_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
WHERE vo.visit_concept_id = 9201
  AND ca.ancestor_concept_id = 255848
  AND co.condition_start_date >= CAST('2025-07-22' AS date)
  AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 1, CAST('2026-07-22' AS date));

content.text:
846 inpatient encounters included a pneumonia diagnosis in the past year.

I counted distinct `visit_occurrence_id` where:
- `visit_concept_id = 9201` (`Inpatient Visit`)
- diagnosis was `Pneumonia` or descendant of SNOMED concept `255848`
- diagnosis date was from `2025-07-22` through `2026-07-22`.
